decisions.reason: This air cooled condenser remains close to the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, and with in-house R&D, testing capacity and customer learning we can still improve and commercialize it effectively.
The tube liner is tightly linked to our installed-base service business and corrosion know-how, so our existing knowledge and field feedback make it a strong candidate to retain.
The customized industrial air cooler line fits our solution-engineering model and broad customer base very well, and its modular learning potential across projects supports keeping it on the market.
These repair inserts build directly on our maintenance and repair capabilities, and our service organization can continue to refine and sell them with relatively low knowledge risk.
